PREP.description: State your main point, explain the reasoning behind it, provide a supporting example, and restate the point to drive it home

steps.label: Example
steps.hint: give a real case or personal story

STAR.description: Describe a specific situation and your required task, explain the exact actions you took, and highlight the final result

steps.label: Result
steps.hint: what was the outcome, be specific

What? So What? Now What?.description: Describe a situation, explain why it is significant or impactful, and conclude with the next logical steps to take

steps.label: What
steps.hint: describe what happened or the topic

Rule of Three.description: Introduce three distinct points or ideas and then tie them together into a single, cohesive message

SCORE.description: Outline the current situation and its challenges, weigh your available options, and recommend a specific path for execution

steps.label: Challenges
steps.hint: identify the core problem or obstacle

steps.label: Execution
steps.hint: outline the next steps for success

SEE-I.description: State a concept clearly, elaborate on its meaning, provide a real-world example, and use an analogy to illustrate the idea

steps.label: State
steps.hint: make your claim in one sentence

steps.label: Illustrate
steps.hint: analogy or image that makes it stick
